item.text: The services already handle permission checks and publishing, so I’ll put the lock checks there, immediately after authorization. Invitation acceptance will check the lock after validating the token and before creating a membership.

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
services = {
    'issue': {'createIssue': 'input.orgId', 'updateIssue': 'input.orgId', 'changeIssueStatus': 'input.orgId', 'assignIssue': 'input.orgId', 'archiveIssue': 'orgId'},
    'project': {'createProject': 'input.orgId', 'updateProject': 'input.orgId', 'archiveProject': 'input.orgId', 'restoreProject': 'orgId'},
    'comment': {'createComment': 'input.orgId', 'updateComment': 'input.orgId', 'deleteComment': 'input.orgId'},
    'label': {'createLabel': 'input.orgId', 'updateLabel': 'input.orgId', 'deleteLabel': 'orgId'},
    'attachment': {'addAttachment': 'input.orgId', 'removeAttachment': 'input.orgId'},
    'member': {'updateMemberRole': 'input.orgId', 'removeMember': 'input.orgId'},
    'invitation': {'inviteMembers': 'input.orgId', 'revokeInvitation': 'actor.orgId', 'resendInvitation': 'actor.orgId'},
    'organization': {'updateOrganization': 'input.orgId'},
    'feature-flag': {'toggleFlag': 'input.orgId'},
    'webhook': {'createWebhook': 'input.orgId', 'updateWebhook': 'input.orgId', 'deleteWebhook': 'input.orgId'},
}
for service, functions in services.items():
    path = Path(f'src/server/services/{service}-service.ts')
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    result = []
    current = None
    inserted = set()
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith('export async function '):
            current = line.split('export async function ')[1].split('(')[0]
        result.append(line)
        if current in functions and line.strip().startswith('assertCan('):
            assert line.rstrip().endswith(');'), (service, current)
            result.append(f'  await assertWorkspaceWritable({functions[current]});\\n')
            inserted.add(current)
    assert inserted == set(functions), (service, inserted)
    content = ''.join(result)
    marker = 'import { assertCan } from \"@/lib/permissions\";'
    content = content.replace(marker, marker + '\\nimport { assertWorkspaceWritable } from \"./billing-service\";')
    if service == 'invitation':
        marker = '  const existing = await memberRepo.findMember(invitation.orgId, userId);'
        assert marker in content
        content = content.replace(marker, '  await assertWorkspaceWritable(invitation.orgId);\\n\\n' + marker)
    path.write_text(content)
PY"
